scope: Review of MAP1013A01 and MAP1013B01 map lifecycle, route cache, boarding decisions, repository writes and manual travel edits

findings.issue: Boarding decision confirms unrelated following travel within a 30-minute window
findings.fix: Match selected IDs or a unique saved journey instead of a dwell time window

findings.issue: Forgotten or manually changed confirmations are reapplied by a retained boarding decision
findings.fix: Remove the selected journey from previous boarding decisions and clear obsolete route geometry and provenance while keeping other targets

findings.issue: Overlapping travel spans can select another travel ID's saved subway route
findings.fix: Prioritize exact route ID; allow only an unambiguous missing-ID fallback; exclude routes already represented by another current travel

findings.issue: Candidate deletion publishes suppression and dismisses the sheet even when saving fails
findings.fix: Share staged decision writes with confirmation, publish only after the write and current revision check, and keep the sheet on failure

debugBuild.signingFlag: --verbose=2 forces Xcode signing to rerun after previously observed stale incremental App Intents metadata

coverage: Following journey remains unchanged; regenerated and slightly shifted same journey retains confirmed geometry

Manual cancellation and mode change clear replay state and obsolete subway geometry
